hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Production wing valve
function: The valve on the production side of the cross, upstream of the choke, that isolates the flowline from the well.

tabs.overview: Manual gate valve; a hydraulic wing is used where a surface safety system shuts the flowline.
tabs.safety: Closed to work on the choke or flowline.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
